name: uptime_s
doc: Seconds since boot from the monotonic clock. Never accumulated, so it cannot drift.

name: interval_due
sig: interval_due(last: Option<u64>, now: u64, interval: u64) -> bool
doc: True when `interval` ms have passed since `last` (None = never ran = due). Saturating: a `last` in the future is not due unless interval is 0.

name: whole_minutes
doc: Whole minutes in a duration.

name: tenths_of_minute
doc: Minutes in tenths, rounded half up, saturating.

name: make_anchor
sig: make_anchor(date: u64, t_req_ms: u64, now: u64) -> Option<Anchor>
doc: Build a time anchor from an HTTP Date header value, or None when the inputs are implausible.

name: boot_bound
doc: Upper bound on the unix second of this boot, from an anchor.

name: judge_age
sig: judge_age(anchor: Option<Anchor>, boot_unix: Option<u64>, now: u64, date: Option<u64>) -> Age
doc: How old is a message dated `date`? Errs on the side of older.

name: decide
sig: decide(cmd: Cmd, age: Age, door_open: bool) -> Decision
doc: What a command does, given its age verdict and the door.

name: on_update
sig: on_update(s: State, u: UpdateIn, now: u64, door_open: bool) -> (State, bool)
doc: Process one update of the batch. bool = press the relay now.

name: on_poll
sig: on_poll(s: State, p: PollResult, now: u64) -> State
doc: Account for a finished getUpdates call.

name: closed_notice
doc: The 'door closed after X.Y minutes' notice, when a bot close was pending and the door was open long enough.

name: open_alert_due
doc: Is an open-door alert due on this pass?

name: close_timeout_due
doc: Has a pending bot close timed out without being reported yet?

name: door_tick
sig: door_tick(d: DoorState, now: u64, open: bool) -> (DoorState, DoorEvents)
doc: Door monitoring for one pass: open alerts, close timeout, closed notice.

name: op_budget_ms
doc: Deadline the shell must enforce on an op.

name: deaf
doc: No successful poll for DEAF_REBOOT_AFTER_MS (counted from boot when there was none yet).

name: pick_op
sig: pick_op(n: State, now: u64, overrun: bool, wifi_up: bool) -> Op
doc: The priority chain: which single op this pass performs.

name: overrun
doc: Was the previous pass more than the watchdog timeout ago, or did the clock go back?

name: send_done
sig: send_done(s: State, m: Msg, ok: bool) -> State
doc: The shell reports how the send of `m` went: after a failure `m` goes back into its slot, unless SEND_TRIES sends in a row have failed.

name: queue_door_events
sig: queue_door_events(s: State, ev: DoorEvents, door_open: bool) -> State
doc: Put this pass's door events into the pending slots; a closed door first drops the open-door ones.

name: wifi_track
sig: wifi_track(since: Option<u64>, now: u64, wifi_up: bool) -> Option<u64>
doc: Since when WiFi has been down (None while it is up).

name: op_done
sig: op_done(s: State, op: Op, now: u64) -> State
doc: Clear the slot the chosen op serves, or stamp the poll time, or clear the update flag.

name: step
doc: One loop pass of the core.

name: text_push
doc: Append bytes; all or nothing; overflow is sticky.

name: div10
doc: One decimal step: `(v / 10, v % 10)`.

name: dec
doc: Decimal digits of `v`, right-aligned in 20 bytes; digits are `b[i..]`, bytes before `i` are 0.

name: div60
doc: Quotient and remainder by 60: `(v / 60, v % 60)`.

name: text_push_u64
doc: Append a decimal number.

name: text_push_i64
doc: Append a signed decimal number.

name: text_push_pad6
doc: Append a decimal number right-aligned with spaces in 6 columns (never truncated).

name: json_escape
doc: One byte escaped for the inside of a JSON string: the bytes and how many (1, 2 or 6).

name: text_push_json
doc: Append bytes escaped for the inside of a JSON string.

name: push_mention
doc: Append `@name ` unless the name is empty.

name: render_closed_after
doc: `@name Door closed after X.Y minutes.`

name: render_diag
doc: The reply to the debug command.

name: render_reply
sig: render_reply(o: Outgoing, version: &[u8], d: Diag) -> Text
doc: The text of a reply to a command.

name: render_msg
sig: render_msg(m: Msg, notify: &[u8], version: &[u8], d: Diag) -> Text
doc: The Telegram message text for a Msg.

name: render_send_body
doc: JSON body for sendMessage.

name: render_poll_path
doc: URL path and query for getUpdates.

name: render_log
sig: render_log(uptime_s: u64, level: Level, free_mem: u32, msg: &[u8]) -> Text
doc: One log line in the format the log server parses.

name: render_heartbeat
doc: The HEARTBEAT log message.

name: render_heap
doc: The HEAP telemetry line.

name: parse_command
doc: Recognise a command word the way main.py does.

name: parse_u64
doc: 1 to 19 ASCII digits.

name: parse_i64
doc: Optional minus sign, then 1 to 18 ASCII digits.

name: parse_http_date
doc: IMF-fixdate HTTP Date header to unix seconds.

name: lex_step
doc: JSON tokenizer, one byte.

name: classify_key
sig: classify_key(on: u8, in_from: bool, k: &[u8]) -> Key
doc: Which known JSON key the bytes spell at a path level.

name: name_from
doc: Validate captured bytes as a username.

name: walk_tmp_append
doc: Append one byte to the scratch buffer, or mark it overflowed when full.

name: walk_finish_scalar
doc: A scalar value ended: store it where its key says and clear the scratch.

name: walk_open
doc: `{` or `[`: one level deeper, following the path to the fields of an update.

name: walk_close
doc: `}` or `]`: one level up; closing an update object hands the update out.

name: walk_str_start
doc: A string opens: decide what to capture (key, message text, username, nothing).

name: walk_str_end
doc: A string closes: classify a key, or store the captured text or username.

name: walk_scalar
doc: One byte of a number or literal: captured when its key is ok, update_id, date or id.

name: walk_step
doc: JSON structure tracker, one token.

name: scan_byte
doc: Tokenizer plus tracker, one byte.

name: scan_finish
doc: Was the body one complete JSON value with ok:true?

name: to_update_in
doc: Reduce a parsed update to what the core needs.

name: inbox_push
doc: Queue a parsed update; a full inbox is unchanged.

name: inbox_pop
doc: Take the oldest parsed update.

name: version_newer
doc: `a` is a strictly later release than `b` (major, then minor, then patch).

name: parse_version
doc: `[v]MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[+build]`, each part 1 to 5 digits and at most 65535.

name: ota_plan
sig: ota_plan(running: Version, m: Manifest, slot_size: u32, bad: Option<Version>) -> bool
doc: Download the manifest's image? Only a strictly newer version that fits the slot and is not the one that just rolled back.

name: ota_accept
sig: ota_accept(running: Version, m: Manifest, slot_size: u32, d: Download) -> bool
doc: Boot the downloaded image? Only if size, SHA-256 and embedded version match the manifest and the install is still allowed.

name: ota_mark_valid
doc: Confirm a freshly installed image? Only after it completed a successful Telegram poll.

name: bot_step
doc: One loop pass. The shell calls this once per pass, right after feeding the watchdog.

name: bot_feed
doc: One byte of a getUpdates response body.

name: bot_poll_done
sig: bot_poll_done(b: Bot, http_ok: bool, date_hdr: &[u8], t_req_ms: u64, now: u64) -> Bot
doc: The getUpdates exchange is over.

name: bot_next_update
sig: bot_next_update(b: Bot, chat_id: i64, now: u64, door_open: bool) -> (Bot, bool)
doc: Act on the next queued update. bool = press the relay now.

name: bot_send_done
sig: bot_send_done(b: Bot, m: Msg, ok: bool) -> Bot
doc: The shell calls this after every Op::Send, with the message and whether Telegram accepted it.

name: bot_http_result
sig: bot_http_result(b: Bot, ok: bool, sock_err: bool) -> Bot
doc: Count an HTTP call for the diagnostics.
